Follow-up: near puff sleeve and cuff isolated from the existing forward donor and fitted independently through all 18 running poses. Original source arm released from erroneous local cloth ownership, existing torso/neckline fit retained. No new painted body, source warp, retiming, registration change or runtime AI. limitations: Partial skin-proof overlap counts are descriptive, not exhaustive anatomy evidence. Original head/hands and outside-ownership bytes remain exact; source shape may be covered or extended only by explicit owned cloth.
